title: Adopter intervention starter
prompt: How should an outside team evaluate ACP without depending on Relay internals?

contributions.body: A real adopter should be able to drive ACP from the public API and inspect the resulting cycle.
contributions.evidenceText: Protocol adoption depends on stable boundaries, not private service imports.

contributions.body: The starter should preserve ACP terms like cycle, condition, routing, digest, response, and export.
contributions.evidenceText: Renaming core objects makes compatibility hard to evaluate.

contributions.body: Evidence artifacts should be produced by the run itself so a reviewer can inspect what happened.
contributions.evidenceText: A useful starter leaves behind more than a success message.

responses.body: That public boundary is the part an outside implementer can rely on.
